name: Shiguangzhi de Qiuye
source:
If everything you love is destined to be swallowed by the tide of time, would you still choose to fight for it?

Akiba of time is a science-fiction visual novel centered on Akihabara, an AI idol, and the butterfly effects of time.

The year is 2036. Akihabara.

Shu Hoshino is an ordinary otaku who loves “Kotoha Akiba,” an AI girl idol who has long since faded from the spotlight. He also loves Akihabara itself — a town that is slowly losing the colors of anime, games, and otaku culture.

An assassination attempt on the Prime Minister suddenly drags him into a time-spanning operation from the future. The future of war is rewritten, but Akihabara is pushed toward another kind of destruction.

The streets once filled with anime, games, figures, maid cafés, and otaku culture are about to be swallowed by the unstoppable tide known as “progress.”

This is a story about protecting what you love.

Shu Hoshino has no extraordinary intelligence, no outstanding physical ability, and none of the qualities needed to become a hero.

He is simply a socially awkward and timid otaku, swept up by the currents of the era.

All he can rely on is his obsession with Akihabara — and the AI girl idol who has always been by his side.

And when everyone believes that change is inevitable, he must make a choice:

To weep alone, or to reclaim the glory that was lost.
translation:
如果你所爱的一切注定会被时间的洪流吞噬，你还会选择去争取吗？

《时之秋叶》是一部以人工智能偶像秋叶原和时之蝴蝶效应为中心的科幻视觉小说。

时间是2036年。秋叶原。

星野修是一名普通宅男，热爱早已淡出聚光灯的人工智能少女偶像“秋叶琴叶”。他也喜欢秋叶原本身——这个小镇正在慢慢失去动漫、游戏和御宅族文化的色彩。

一场针对首相的暗杀企图突然将他拖入一场来自未来的穿越行动。战争的未来被改写，秋叶原却被推向另一种毁灭。

曾经充斥着动漫、游戏、手办、女仆咖啡馆和御宅族文化的街道，即将被不可阻挡的“进步”浪潮所吞噬。

这是一个关于保护自己所爱之物的故事。

星野修没有过人的智力，没有出众的身体能力，更没有成为英雄所需要的品质。

他只是一个不善社交、胆怯的御宅族，被时代潮流所卷入。

他能依靠的，只有对秋叶原的执念——以及一直陪伴在他身边的AI少女偶像。

而当每个人都相信改变不可避免时，他必须做出选择：

独自哭泣，或者夺回失去的荣耀。
